name: Dasha
source:
DASHA is a choice-based visual novel. You are Nathan. You followed Dasha off a balcony. She moved through the city. You moved too. There was a gyro cart, some rooms, a subway. People told you things about her. You could believe them or not. By morning you had to produce something for an editor.

There is no affection meter. There is a night. Then a deadline. Then you decide what the night was about.
(Source: Itch.io https://yuhboy2clout.itch.io/dasha)
